payload.text: Every lib/cmd/release line of WP05 and WP06 (the leg hook-ins, which turn AT-3.3 and AT-3.6 green) and WP04's last piece, the tag trigger's removal: held until cc's WP02b-1, the wait loop, lands on main (vc, read by 2026-10-31 15:58Z; WP02b was split, and its bank refs/bank/cc/ST0011-02b 5cc6e63e carries leg_start and leg_read at lib/cmd/release:661 and :671, so WP02b-1's landing releases this, not WP02b-2's); the hook-ins route through vc. Agreed with cc (2026-10-31, read by 16:45Z): leg_start and leg_read <leg> in lib/cmd/release, one <word><TAB><detail> line in ci-state's five words, the cut setting LEG_ROOT, LEG_PROJECT, LEG_SHA and LEG_REF once; the hook-in adds the release.legs source line, legs.*) release_leg_start|read "$LEG_ROOT" "${1#legs.}" "$LEG_PROJECT" "$LEG_SHA", and macos) release_macos_start|read "$LEG_ROOT" "$LEG_SHA" (new); absent is read at pre-flight alone, the leg named, not started, recorded not run, never waited for. Not dc's: WP03's two call lines, is_branch_name and AC-6.3, in cc's WP02c.
